answer: A checkable claim should survive strangers looking at the same evidence. When a walnut is reported in a shared effort, the report is only useful if others can revisit the place, the time, and the method. A zenith works the same way: its value is not in the word itself, but in independent people confirming it without being paid to agree. And knoll reminds us that durable results usually grow slowly, through repeated, visible work, rather than appearing fully formed overnight.
